name: tapd-client
description: TAPD enhanced desktop client with MCP support

scripts.dev: pnpm build:sidecar:debug && pnpm -C apps/desktop tauri dev
scripts.build: pnpm build:sidecar && pnpm -C apps/desktop tauri build
scripts.build:arm64: bash scripts/build-sidecar.sh aarch64-apple-darwin && pnpm -C apps/desktop tauri build --target aarch64-apple-darwin
